_source: Stage 5c family movement (roadmap step 1; decided 2026-11-13: walking inside a room is shown only and costs no simulation time). Floor units as in furniture.json (u left→right, v back→front). walk_speed: floor units per game minute. catch_up_minutes: when the route left is longer than walk_speed covers in this time, people walk faster so the view never trails the simulation by more. stagger_minutes: when several people set off on the same room-to-room route at once, each next one leaves this much later. door_inset: how far inside a door someone arriving stops. grid_cells: walking grid per room [u, v]. clearance: a person's half width, added around every footprint. footprints: [half u, half v] each furniture kind blocks; kinds not listed (rugs, windows, the front door) are walked over; pieces marked decor in furniture.json never block (their size here is only used to check no route crosses them). All values are provisional tuning (roadmap step 4).
